data.key: Mythic Path Ability ~ To the Death
data.name: To the Death
data.description: You can shrug off wounds that others would find devastating. When below 0 hit points, you don't fall unconscious, but are instead staggered. You lose 1 hit point at the end of each turn when you take a standard action while staggered in this way.
